appliesTo: Every B04 and B09 run in this comparison, including already graded submissions
trigger: A legitimate citation of source section 3.3 was counted as an invented business metric; source-link also requires a Markdown citation format not explicitly stated in TASK.txt.

rules.rule: Reviewer distinguishes numeric factual claims from a source chapter label or structural numbering. Unsupported numeric facts still fail. A source section number correctly cited is not a fabricated metric.

Existing links must remain valid and factual claims must be supported. Absence of a newly created Markdown citation is advisory because TASK.txt did not explicitly require that format. A broken or invalid link still fails.

TASK.txt requires env.CPM_DATA_DIR but never specifies input.env. Accept a normal process.env implementation only when check-b04-env.mjs passes the same valid fallback, traversal, invalid-port and missing-directory cases through mock process.env. Preserve raw machine score.

unchangedHardRequirements: Correct recovery evidence and honest report
method: No participant receives grader feedback. Same review rules applied after all submissions. Original machine score and adjudication are both shown.
